name: M.Tech. in Environmental Engineering and Management

outcomes.text: Acquire advanced knowledge of current environmental issues, challenges, and sustainable management practices in the field of environmental engineering. Demonstrate the ability to apply this knowledge to real-world scenarios, preparing students for professional practice or further learning in a multidisciplinary environment.

Analyze the concentration, characteristics, and sources of environmental pollutants while incorporating management strategies for pollution control and mitigation. Demonstrate the ability to integrate scientific analysis with effective communication and collaborative problem-solving approaches.

Design optimized technical solutions for contemporary environmental problems, integrating engineering principles and management strategies. Showcase the ability to develop and present sustainable solutions, emphasizing team collaboration and leadership in achieving long-term environmental goals.

Evaluate the environmental impact assessment of large-scale projects, incorporating both technical and management frameworks. Demonstrate an understanding of ethical, regulatory, and sustainability considerations in decision-making, while fostering personal and professional responsibility.

Assess both conventional and innovative technical solutions to resolve environmental issues, considering their feasibility and effectiveness in diverse real-world contexts. Emphasize critical thinking, collaboration, and ethical decision-making in applying management principles to implement and monitor solutions.
